purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.

audit_findings: The aggregate family resolves the registry slash without allowing grant and donation instances to become interchangeable.

Autonomous award, agreement, restriction waiver, cost approval, payment, tax conclusion, disclosure, clawback, return and destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
